Hi Marta — attaching our completed Q&A workbook and a SCIM attribute mapping CSV. Below is an executive summary followed by concise technical responses keyed to your RFP items. If you want us to paste these directly into your template, say the word and we will.

[Attachment: redwood_iam_qna_v1.xlsx]
[Attachment: scim_attribute_map.csv]

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (IdP/SP, SP-initiated + IdP-initiated), OIDC (Authorization Code + PKCE, Authorization Code without PKCE for confidential clients, and Client Credentials for machine-to-machine). SAML SLO is supported for IdP-initiated flows; we recommend token/session expiry for SP-driven session termination in some embedded use cases.

- SCIM: Full SCIM 2.0 provisioning with support for create, read, update, delete; incremental (delta) syncs and full re-sync supported. Group objects are supported; we also offer configurable mapping for nested groups via a SCIM extension (see scim_attribute_map.csv). Rate limits: default 100 req/min for provisioning endpoints with upgrade paths for dedicated customers.

- RBAC & Admin controls: Role-based access within each customer tenant. Pre-defined roles: Org Admin, Identity Admin (SCIM patch rights), App Admin (SSO config only), Read-only Auditor. Delegated admin is tenant-scoped; Org Admins can further delegate subset roles limited to specific products/environments. Admin actions are audited and tied to user identity via SSO.

- Audit & evidence: Audit logs include admin actions, SCIM provisioning events, SSO assertion events (logged at token/transaction level), and certificate change events. Logs retain 365 days by default; extended retention available as an add-on. Evidence: we can provide exported logs and a filtered view for audit; SOC2 report excerpts available under NDA.

- Certificate rotation & secrets: Support automated certificate rollover for SAML metadata endpoints (metadata URL + auto-refresh), and manual rotation via Console/API. We recommend a 90-day rotation cadence for SAML certs; Redwood supports overlapping certificate windows to avoid downtime. Private key material is stored in customer-controlled KMS for Private deployments, and HSM-backed for Dedicated. All secrets are encrypted at rest.

- Additional controls: Conditional session timeouts, IP allowlists, MFA enforcement at SSO layer (we integrate with common IdP MFA policies), and options to require signed SAML assertions.

Operational notes & timeline:
- Standard integration (SP-initiated SAML + SCIM for users + flat groups): 3–5 business days for setup and validation in a test tenant.
- Complex mappings (nested groups, custom attributes): 1–2 weeks depending on map complexity.
- Dedicated customers: we offer scoped provisioning endpoints with higher rate limits and SLA guarantees.

Next steps we propose:
1) Tell us whether you want answers pasted into your RFP spreadsheet or if the attached XLSX is acceptable.
2) Confirm scope (SAML only vs SAML+OIDC; flat vs nested groups).
3) Pick two windows for a 90-minute POC where we provide a test tenant and run SCIM sync + SSO test.

Examples of SCIM support (short technical notes):
- Schema: We adhere to RFC7644 and support custom extension: urn:redwood:scim:2.0:GroupExt to carry nested-group membership via references.
- Delta tokens: We emit change tokens in listResponses to allow delta syncs; provisioning client can use since param.
- Idempotency: SCIM PATCH operations are idempotent; PATCH support uses JSON Patch (RFC 6902).

If you'd like, we can also provide a Redaction/PII mapping for attributes.

Regards,

On Wed, Jul 16, 2025 at 9:10 AM Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@lynxfinancial.com> wrote:
> 1) Nested groups: will the SCIM extension preserve nesting semantics or flatten by default?

We preserve nesting semantics via our urn:redwood:scim:2.0:GroupExt. The default behavior in the base connector is to preserve the structure as group references (not flattened). If your application expects a flattened membership list, we can provide a transform step in the middle (on-provision middleware) that materializes transitive members. This is configurable per-tenant.

> 2) Delegated admin: can delegation be restricted to a subset of tenant namespaces and limited to specific resource types?

Yes. Delegation operates at the tenant namespace level and supports scoping down to specific resource types and product surfaces. Example: you can create a role "Provisioning Admin — BU North" that has SCIM patch rights for users in a tenant namespace limited to "bu_north/*" and explicitly denies billing API actions. Admin UI/API enforces these constraints and each action is logged.

> 3) OIDC: confirm support for PKCE for public clients and multiple redirect URIs per client.

Confirmed: PKCE is supported (recommended for public/native apps). We also support multiple redirect URIs per client and allow per-URI exact-match or prefix-match based on tenant policy.

> 4) For certificate rotation, can you provide the operational playbook?

Attached. Short summary: we recommend staging the new cert in metadata with overlap window of 7 days; validation runs in test tenant; automatic metadata fetch by IdP is supported; notify stakeholders via webhook/console; rollback path is to re-enable old cert within 24 hours. For Dedicated/Private customers we can coordinate rotation windows and perform rotation on your timetable.

If helpful we can schedule a 45-minute call with your infra/security team next week to walk through the playbook and run a live SCIM sync in a test tenant.

Thanks — Sean
